config.title: Zipper
config.intro: Control who can create original-media ZIP packages and set server-wide resource limits. Subtitle choices come from tracks Jellyfin associates with each selected media source.
config.availabilityHelp: These settings affect Zipper for every account. Jellyfin’s own item access and download permissions are still checked for each package.
config.enabledHelp: Allow authenticated users to preview, create, and manage their packages.
config.webEnabledHelp: Show Zipper actions in the Web interface. API clients can still use enabled server features.
config.itemTypesHelp: Choose which logical library items can be packaged.
config.series: Selected seasons or a whole series
config.limitsHelp: Limits apply to streaming packages too. Zipper sends original media without transcoding and does not cache packages or support transfer resume.
config.userConcurrencyHelp: Must be no greater than the server-wide concurrent limit.
config.maxEntriesHelp: Includes media and supported associated subtitle files. Range: 1–10,000.
config.maxBytesHelp: Range: 1 byte to 2 TiB. This caps summed source files; ZIP headers, names, and footer add bounded overhead. For example, 214748364800 is 200 GiB.
config.subtitleFormatsHelp: Zipper includes supported external tracks Jellyfin associates with the selected media source. Embedded subtitles remain inside the original media file.
config.vobsubHelp: VobSub uses a matching .idx and .sub pair. Enable both extensions to include both files.
